environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal) in VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/24. ALB security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b3d5a7f9) ingress rules reference a prefix list (pl-0f2b8c4d6e1a3957) containing only three CIDR blocks: 10.100.0.0/16 (service mesh sidecar egress), 172.16.32.0/21 (CI/CD runner subnet), and 192.168.1.0/24 (on-prem VPN termination). The ALB has no public-facing listener and resides in private subnets with no internet gateway or NAT gateway route to inbound traffic. VPC has no peering connections except to the three authorized networks. Lambda is invoked exclusively via ALB target group integration (not function URL). DNS resolution for the ALB is via Route53 private hosted zone only resolvable from within the VPC.

config.vpc_subnets: private-only, no IGW, no NAT inbound
